Auto Model Router - Automatically select the best model based on task complexity for OpenClaw agents

latestVersion.changelog:
Auto Model Router Skill 1.0.0

- Initial public release.
- Automatically selects the best model for each task category based on user input and model availability.
- Supports 8 major task categories with intelligent classification and model assignment.
- Offers three plans: International (Plan A), Domestic (Plan B), and GLM One-Stop (Plan C).
- Features sub-agent dispatching for unexpected/side tasks.
- Includes fallback logic for unknown tasks or models and easy configuration via commands.
